title: 第21章 有钱人的低调第22章 爷爷是仙人
slug: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
第21章有钱人的低调
校长有一瞬间无语，不知道该说什么好。
遇到像这样无理取闹的人是真的很让人头疼，你说让人道歉也就罢了，你让人磕头认错就有点太过了吧。
这任谁也不乐意啊。
“这...”校长看向郁凡，想知道他的想法。
郁凡只是微笑着看着他，他也摸不清对方家长究竟想怎么样解决。
他想了想，咬咬牙对郁凡说道：“这样，郁凌给冯健道歉，冯健家长需要给予郁凌同学一定的补偿，毕竟是冯健动手在先。”
“我们学校的这个学期的最高奖学金也可以给郁凌，你看怎么样？”校长自认为这样对于郁凌也是有好处的，要知道为了鼓励孩子们学习，学校的最高奖学金可是有三万元，这可不是一个小数目，供一个普通家庭都可以生活个几个月了。
郁凡没想到身为一个学校的校长居然会以利益交换来处理事情，他自认为这样可以解决掉所有的事情，看似偏向了郁凌，实则依然是让郁凌承认这件事是他的错，这对于一个孩子来说，不仅仅是在打击他的自信心，更是伤害了他的自尊心。
“凭什么要我们给他补偿？”曹菊大叫，“哥，你看下他怎么处理事情的，我不同意！”
“我们也不同意。”王老冷声走了进来。
“王，王老，您来了。”校长有些尴尬，没想到自己处理事情的办法会让王老知道。
他赶紧上前一步想要解释，“王老，事情是这样的...双方各自退让几步便罢了，事情闹得太大，对孩子的学习也不好。”
王老不想听到说法，直接摆了摆手，“行了，老原，你不用说了，你想和稀泥我知道，但是凡事还是得讲究一个公平，真正犯错的人是谁，我们都知道，如果你觉得自己没有这个权利去处置一个人，那我建议你还是不要再当这个校长了。”
原校长不敢再说一句话，王老这话说得轻巧，可是这句不让他再继续当校长却让他的心忍不住一抖。
曹东看到王老后眼睛一亮，自己最近有一个项目正是想寻求和王老合作，没想到在这里会碰到他。
听到王老的这一番话，他很快便察觉到王老是在为那些穷人家的孩子们说话。
“王老，您好，鄙人曹东。”说着便拿出自己的的名片双手恭敬的递给王老。
然而王老并未理会他，四大世家可不是只是说说而已，虽然曹东也算是一个亿万富翁，但是要说和王老比起来，还是差很多。
至少在王老眼中可看不上这么一个小商人。

曹东也不生气，他很自然的将手中的名片收了回来。
“王老，这都是孩子们之间闹着玩，这些事情其实挺好解决的，孩子的矛盾也不必这么严肃。”
“是吗？我刚才可是听到了说要开除谁来着？”王老冷眼盯着曹东。
曹东连忙打着哈哈，“这都是开玩笑，就吓吓他们。”
王老便不再说话。
然而随后的一个动作让曹东瞪大了眼睛。
只见王老一脸恭敬的朝着郁凡鞠躬，“郁神医，您受委屈了。”
郁凡朝着王老点点头，“事情就交给你处理了，还有这些孩子们，我希望都能妥善安排好。”
郁凡朝着郁凌身后的方向指了指，王老看了看那些孩子们，一瞬间便了然了。
“放心，郁神医，我会处理好的。”
郁凌可以随时转学，去其他学校读书，可是那些孩子们呢？
他们如果继续留在这个学校可能就会承受来着冯健的报复，有些孩子得恶劣可不是那么简单的。
然而让他们全部都转学，很显然也不现实。
不说孩子们的家庭状况，转学毕竟是大事，对于孩子的学习和各方面都会有影响。
看到王老对郁凡的恭敬，这下校长和刘主任都慌了，这个人到底是谁？为什么四大家族的王老会对他这么恭敬？
第21章有钱人的低调
两人对视一眼，便知道这下完了，自己正好已经将这人得罪了。
曹东更是流下冷汗，一把拉住还准备叫嚷的曹菊，训斥道：“闭嘴。”
曹菊从来没见过她哥哥这么生气，抬头便发现她哥脸白的厉害。
她有些不明所以，但也瞬间意识到了有什么不对，也不敢再囔囔了。

郁凡直接将垂头丧气的郁凌给带走了。
content_en:
Chapter 21 The low profile of rich people
The principal was speechless for a moment, not knowing what to say.
It's really troublesome to meet such unreasonable people. If you ask people to apologize, that's it. If you ask them to kowtow and admit their mistakes, it's a bit too much.
No one is happy with this.
"This..." The principal looked at Yu Fan, wanting to know what he was thinking.
Yu Fan just looked at him with a smile. He couldn't figure out how the other parent wanted to solve the problem.
He thought for a while, gritted his teeth and said to Yu Fan: "In this way, Yu Ling apologizes to Feng Jian, and Feng Jian's parents need to give Yu Ling a certain amount of compensation. After all, it was Feng Jian who took action first."
"Our school's highest scholarship for this semester can also be given to Yu Ling. What do you think?" The principal believes that this is also good for Yu Ling. You must know that in order to encourage children to study, the school's highest scholarship is 30,000 yuan. This is not a small amount, and can support an ordinary family for several months.
Yu Fan didn't expect that as a school principal, he would deal with things in exchange for benefits. He thought that this could solve everything. He seemed to favor Yu Ling, but in fact he still made Yu Ling admit that this matter was his fault. For a child, this not only hurt his self-confidence, but also hurt his self-esteem.
"Why should we compensate him?" Cao Ju shouted, "Brother, look at how he handles things, I don't agree!"
"We don't agree either." Mr. Wang walked in coldly.
"Wang, Mr. Wang, you're here." The principal was a little embarrassed. He didn't expect that his way of handling things would be known to Mr. Wang.
He hurriedly stepped forward to explain, "Mr. Wang, here's the thing... both sides just need to make a few concessions. The matter is too big and it's not good for the children's learning."
Mr. Wang didn't want to hear the explanation, so he waved his hand directly, "Okay, Lao Yuan, you don't have to say anything. I know you want to make peace, but you still have to pay attention to fairness in everything. We all know who is the real person who made the mistake. If you feel that you do not have the right to deal with a person, then I suggest that you stop being the principal."
The former principal did not dare to say another word. Mr. Wang said it lightly, but his words about not allowing him to continue to be the principal made his heart tremble.
Cao Dong's eyes lit up when he saw Mr. Wang. He recently had a project and wanted to cooperate with Mr. Wang. He didn't expect to meet him here.
After hearing what Mr. Wang said, he soon realized that Mr. Wang was speaking for the children from poor families.
"Hello, Mr. Wang, I am Cao Dong." With that, he took out his business card and handed it to Mr. Wang respectfully with both hands.
However, Mr. Wang ignored him. The four major aristocratic families were not just talking. Although Cao Dong was also considered a billionaire, compared with Mr. Wang, he was still far behind.
At least in the eyes of Mr. Wang, such a small businessman cannot be looked down upon.
Cao Dong was not angry, he took the business card back naturally.
"Mr. Wang, this is just a joke among the children. These matters are actually quite easy to resolve. Children's conflicts do not need to be so serious."
"Really? I just heard who was being fired?" Mr. Wang stared at Cao Dong coldly.
Cao Dong quickly yelled, "This is all a joke, just scare them."
Mr. Wang stopped talking.
However, a subsequent movement made Cao Dong's eyes widen.
Mr. Wang bowed to Yu Fan respectfully, "Doctor Yu, you have been wronged."
Yu Fan nodded towards Mr. Wang, "I'll leave the matter to you, and I hope these children can be properly arranged."
Yu Fan pointed in the direction behind Yu Ling. Mr. Wang looked at the children and understood in an instant.
"Don't worry, Doctor Yu, I will take care of it."
Yu Ling can transfer to other schools at any time, but what about those children?If they continue to stay in this school, they may suffer Feng Jian's revenge. It is not that simple for some children to be bad.
However, it is obviously unrealistic to ask them all to transfer schools.
Not to mention the children's family situation, changing schools is a major event after all, and will have an impact on children's learning and all aspects.
Seeing Mr. Wang's respect for Yu Fan, the principal and Director Liu panicked. Who is this person? Why are the Wang Lao of the four major families so respectful to him?
Chapter 21 The low profile of rich people
The two of them looked at each other and knew it was over. They had just offended this person.
Cao Dong broke into a cold sweat, grabbed Cao Ju who was about to yell, and scolded: "Shut up."
Cao Ju had never seen her brother so angry. When she looked up, she saw that her brother's face was extremely pale.
She was a little confused, but she instantly realized something was wrong and didn't dare to complain anymore.
Yu Fan took the dejected Yu Ling away directly.
